question: Should the shared model-facing `web_search` schema permanently expose Perplexity-specific `search_context_size`, including both native Search API and Sonar/OpenRouter compatibility behavior?
rationale: The patch adds a new model-facing tool parameter across core and the bundled Perplexity plugin; tests can verify plumbing, but maintainers must confirm that this provider-specific capability belongs in the shared tool contract and that the two transport semantics are the intended product shape.

options.title: Sponsor the shared parameter
options.body: Keep the additive shared schema and require redacted live-provider proof before merge.

options.title: Limit the surface
options.body: Require the parameter to be exposed only through a narrower Perplexity-specific capability if the generic tool contract should remain provider-neutral.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers choose a broader provider-parameter policy for `web_search`.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared parameter
recommendation.body: Keep the additive shared schema and require redacted live-provider proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Perplexity-provider history makes this the best available code-area routing candidate, although product acceptance remains a broader maintainer decision.
